en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a lakeside industrial town surrounded by low hills. In the foreground are factories with tall smokestacks, warehouses, rail or industrial yards, and scattered wooden houses. Across the lake and river lies a dense cluster of houses and larger public buildings on a gently rising hillside, with forested areas and mountains in the distance. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and a photographer's credit mark in the lower right.
